articles.author: Saeed Al Batati
articles.title: A Yemeni family spends a week on the road fleeing another Houthi offensive
articles.description: Displaced Yemenis are fleeing again, as the Houthis capture the Red Sea coast.
articles.content: Mukalla, Yemen When waves of Yemeni government forces started to flee the front lines near al-Khokha, a Red Sea town between Hodeidah and Mocha, two of Saeed Hassans sons rushed to alert their father… [+11148 chars]
